import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 300;
    static final int M = 900000;
    static final int oo = 10000000;
    static int[] dx = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, 1, 0, -1};

    static int[] to = new int[M];
    static int[] cap = new int[M];
    static int[] ant = new int[M];
    static int pa;
    static int n, t;
    static int[] level = new int[N];
    static int[] adj = new int[N];
    static int[] copy_adj = new int[N];
    static int[] fila = new int[N];
    static int S, T;

    static int[][] inds = new int[21][21];
    static int[][] inds2 = new int[21][21];
    static int[][] mk = new int[21][21];
    static char[][] gr = new char[21][21];
    static char[][] gr2 = new char[21][21];
    static int[][] c = new int[21][21];

    static int in;
    static int rp, cp;

    static boolean valid(int a, int b) {
        return a >= 0 && a < n && b >= 0 && b < n;
    }

    static void add(int f, int t, int c) {
        to[pa] = t;
        cap[pa] = c;
        ant[pa] = adj[f];
        adj[f] = pa++;
        // reverse edge
        to[pa] = f;
        cap[pa] = 0;
        ant[pa] = adj[t];
        adj[t] = pa++;
    }

    static boolean bfs(int source, int sink) {
        Arrays.fill(level, -1);
        level[source] = 0;
        int pos = 0, tam = 0;
        fila[tam++] = source;
        while (pos < tam) {
            int now = fila[pos++];
            for (int i = adj[now]; i >= 0; i = ant[i]) {
                if (cap[i] > 0 && level[to[i]] == -1) {
                    level[to[i]] = level[now] + 1;
                    fila[tam++] = to[i];
                }
            }
        }
        return level[sink] != -1;
    }

    static int dfs(int no, int sink, int flow) {
        if (no == sink) return flow;
        for (int i = copy_adj[no]; i >= 0; i = ant[i]) {
            if (cap[i] > 0 && level[no] + 1 == level[to[i]]) {
                int nflow = dfs(to[i], sink, Math.min(flow, cap[i]));
                if (nflow > 0) {
                    cap[i] -= nflow;
                    cap[i ^ 1] += nflow;
                    return nflow;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int maxflow(int source, int sink) {
        int mf = 0;
        while (true) {
            if (bfs(source, sink)) {
                System.arraycopy(adj, 0, copy_adj, 0, adj.length);
                while (true) {
                    int add = dfs(source, sink, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                    if (add > 0) mf += add;
                    else break;
                }
            } else break;
        }
        return mf;
    }

    static void busc(int a, int b) {
        int ini = 0, fim = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(mk[i], 0);
            Arrays.fill(c[i], -1);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (gr[i][j] > '0' && gr[i][j] <= '9') {
                    mk[i][j] = 1;
                }
            }
        }
        q[0] = new Pair(rp, cp);
        q[1] = new Pair(a, b);
        int[] cA = c[a];
        int[] cB = c[rp];
        cA[b] = cB[b] = 0;
        mk[a][b] = 1;
        mk[rp][cp] = 2;
        fim = 2;
        while (ini < fim) {
            Pair now = q[ini++];
            int x = now.x;
            int y = now.y;
            if (mk[x][y] == 1 && gr2[x][y] > '0' && gr2[x][y] <= '9') {
                add(inds[a][b], inds2[x][y], 9);
            }
            if (mk[x][y] == 1 && c[x][y] == t) continue;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int nx = x + dx[i];
                int ny = y + dy[i];
                if (valid(nx, ny) && mk[nx][ny] == 0) {
                    mk[nx][ny] = mk[x][y];
                    c[nx][ny] = c[x][y] + 1;
                    q[fim++] = new Pair(nx, ny);
                } else if (mk[x][y] == 1 && valid(nx, ny) && mk[nx][ny] == 2 && c[nx][ny] == c[x][y] + 1 && gr2[nx][ny] > '0' && gr2[nx][ny] <= '9') {
                    add(inds[a][b], inds2[nx][ny], 9);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static class Pair {
        int x, y;
        Pair(int x, int y) {
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        t = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        S = 202;
        T = 203;
        Arrays.fill(adj, -1);
        pa = 0;
        in = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 21; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(inds[i], -1);
            Arrays.fill(inds2[i], -1);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            gr[i] = br.readLine().toCharArray();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (gr[i][j] > '0' && gr[i][j] <= '9') {
                    add(S, in, gr[i][j] - '0');
                    inds[i][j] = in++;
                }
                if (gr[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    rp = i;
                    cp = j;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            gr2[i] = br.readLine().toCharArray();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (gr2[i][j] > '0' && gr2[i][j] <= '9') {
                    add(in, T, gr2[i][j] - '0');
                    inds2[i][j] = in++;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (gr[i][j] > '0' && gr[i][j] <= '9' && gr2[i][j] > '0' && gr2[i][j] <= '9') {
                    add(inds[i][j], inds2[i][j], 9);
                }
                if (gr[i][j] > '0' && gr[i][j] <= '9') {
                    busc(i, j);
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(maxflow(S, T));
    }
}
